craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of the sealed proof — utsāha as each consequence collapses and the maker stands. Deemed-freed test; occurs-yet-joins-not hinge. Rejected: (a) freed→liberated → killed: freed is nearer. Read aloud: WHY-not, AS-be-FORE … YET-joins-HIM-not.

lines: Why not, as before, for him deemed freed of need?
It still occurs — yet joins him not.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pūrvavan na bhavet kasmāt taṃ muktābhimataṃ prati

reads_against.argmap: Why not for the deemed-freed? → Occurrence without union — the freed-spirit test.
c1_essence: The svabhāva-view's consequences pressed: desired-by-all yet body-changes by nature; occurrence without union; needlessness fitting neither spirit nor mind; no reunion yet rebirth; mokṣa collapsed into nature; compassion-acts forcing passion-exhaustion doctrine (vv46-51).
The siddhānta sealed: nature-view abandoned as unjust, bodies famously sentient-maker-prior, arrangement-difference the flawless proof, the hetu aimed at Parameśvara unshaken (vv52-54).
